```{r setup}
#| label: setup-libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

# Load test datasets generated from LOTUS DB schema and ps_monitoring_tables_AI.xlsx
lotus_data <- read_csv("mock_lotus_observer_data.csv")
ps_summary <- read_csv("mock_ps_monitoring_summary.csv")
```

#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Protected Species Interaction & Anomaly Baseline Summary Table"

# Process summary statistics and evaluate threshold triggers
ps_compiled <- ps_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Exceedance_Probability = pmin(1.0, pmax(0.01, 1 - pnorm(ITS_5Yr_Limit, mean = Expanded_Estimate, sd = 12))),
    Anomaly_Status = if_else(
      Expanded_Estimate > Historical_Mean_5Yr * 1.2 | Exceedance_Probability > 0.15,
      "FLAGGED FOR REVIEW",
      "TYPICAL"
    )
  )

ps_compiled %>%
  select(Species, Observed_Takes, Coverage_Rate, Expanded_Estimate, Historical_Mean_5Yr, ITS_5Yr_Limit, Anomaly_Status) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Species", "Observed", "Coverage", "Expanded Est.", "5-Yr Hist. Mean", "5-Yr ITS Limit", "Anomaly Status"),
    digits = 2,
    align = "lcccccc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
  ```
  #| label: gemini-causal-narrative
#| output: asis

# 1. Extract flagged species for narrative drafting
flagged_species <- ps_compiled %>% filter(Anomaly_Status == "FLAGGED FOR REVIEW")

# 2. Define Function to Query Gemini API
call_gemini_gem <- function(species_name, obs_takes, exp_est, hist_mean, its_limit) {
  
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY")
  
  # Fallback to local structured narrative generation if API Key is not set
  if (nchar(api_key) == 0) {
    return(paste0(
      "> **[Simulated Gemini Gem Output for ", species_name, "]**\n\n",
      "**Causal Narrative & Qualitative Diagnostic:**\n",
      "During the current reporting period, observed interactions for **", species_name, "** reached ", obs_takes, 
      " individual(s), yielding an expanded fleet-wide interaction estimate of **", round(exp_est, 1), "**.\n\n",
      "- **Historical Comparison:** This expanded estimate exceeds the 5-year historical baseline mean of ", hist_mean, ".\n",
      "- **ITS Compliance:** The projected cumulative count is evaluating against the 5-year Incidental Take Statement (ITS) cap of ", its_limit, ".\n",
      "- **Environmental & Spatial Drivers:** Oceanographic data indicate a sea surface temperature (SST) anomaly and localized fleet effort shift toward the $17.5^\\circ\\text{C}-18.5^\\circ\\text{C}$ dynamic band. "
    ))
  }
  
  # System Prompt framing Gemini as an expert WPRFMC Environmental Decision Analyst
  prompt_text <- paste0(
    "You are an expert Environmental Decision Analyst for the Western Pacific Regional Fishery Management Council (WPRFMC).\n",
    "Draft a professional, objective causal narrative for the SAFE Report protected species section based on these data:\n",
    "- Species: ", species_name, "\n",
    "- Observed Takes (LOTUS): ", obs_takes, "\n",
    "- Expanded Fleet Interaction Estimate: ", round(exp_est, 1), "\n",
    "- 5-Year Historical Mean: ", hist_mean, "\n",
    "- 5-Year ITS Cap: ", its_limit, "\n\n",
    "Requirements:\n",
    "1. Explain potential environmental (SST/EKE shifts), gear, or spatial fleet drivers.\n",
    "2. Assess compliance relative to the ESA Biological Opinion Incidental Take Statement (ITS).\n",
    "3. Provide recommended management or monitoring next steps for the Pelagic Plan Team."
  )
  
  req <- request(paste0("[https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=](https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=)", api_key)) %>%
    req_headers("Content-Type" = "application/json") %>%
    req_body_json(list(
      contents = list(list(parts = list(list(text = prompt_text))))
    ))
  
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  result <- resp_body_json(resp)
  return(result$candidates[[1]]$content$parts[[1]]$text)
}

# 3. Iterate over flagged species and print generated narratives
if (nrow(flagged_species) > 0) {
  for (i in 1:nrow(flagged_species)) {
    sp <- flagged_species[i, ]
    narrative <- call_gemini_gem(
      species_name = sp$Species,
      obs_takes = sp$Observed_Takes,
      exp_est = sp$Expanded_Estimate,
      hist_mean = sp$Historical_Mean_5Yr,
      its_limit = sp$ITS_5Yr_Limit
    )
    cat(narrative, "\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*No protected species triggered the anomaly threshold during this evaluation period. All interaction rates remain within historical parameters.*\n")
}
```
